title: Seed Collection
text: “Hmm… I never thought it would come to this…”
My Father groans after being reprimanded by the Panda Beastman.
“Motoyasu, what are you going to do?”
“I know exactly what to do. It’s just the right time for logging, isn’t it? I, Motoyasu, will take care of this myself.”

It was definitely the right decision not to plant them in Melromarc. After all, look at what happened when we planted it in the Siltvelt wilderness. Of course, since I’d warned them—and even provided a letter of introduction—that it might be dangerous, the government has designated this area as off-limits.

If they ignored the government’s instructions and came near, it’s their own fault. I check the area regularly. Since the mutation hasn’t been going on for very long, the affected area is still small. In fact, you can still see the main body of the bio-plant from the edge of the forest.
“Well then, let’s go, Yuki-chan!”
“Understood.”

Riding on Yuki-chan’s back, I approach the Bio-Plant, which is starting to grow rapidly like a bean stalk. There’s also a monster called a Plant-Rewe, but we’ll ignore it. Our top priority is to destroy the main body first. Just then, the Bio-Plant turned a part that looked like a flower with teeth toward us and tried to bite.
“You’re too naive!”
With me still on her back, Yuki-chan did a backflip to dodge the vines the Bio-Plant fired at us. She kicked the vines aside, then slid along one of them to close in.
“Gungnir!”

I unleashed my spear skills at the Bio-Plant’s flower-like part. With a sound like leaves being torn apart, the flower-like part was blown away, but the Bio-Plant kept moving without any apparent issues.
This is a hassle. It seems there’s a main body somewhere. If my future Father had encountered a rampage like this, how would he have dealt with it? It would be easy to take it down.
If I just burned this area with Magic, it’d be a piece of cake. But then, there’s a high chance we wouldn’t be able to recover the Bio Plant’s seeds, and it might even sprout again.

……Come to think of it, I seem to recall my Father mentioning something about herbicide recently. In fact, he’s calling out “herbicide” from the rear right now. I see—since this monster is indeed a plant, herbicide would certainly be effective. It should work well on this land, too.
“Wow… I’m not about to lose to this!”
The panda beastman seems to be trying to one-up something. She’s crossed her arms and is concentrating.
“Be the source of power. I command you. Interpret the laws once more, O Great Plant. Pierce these fools!”
“Spite Bamboo Spike!”
When the panda beastwoman slammed her fist into the ground, bamboo shot up from the earth and impaled the surrounding monsters.
“Whoa! That cool sis is awesome, just like I thought! I’m gonna do it too!”
“Wait, Keel! It’s dangerous to charge in recklessly, so don’t stray too far.”
“……Sakura will do her best, too.”
Sakura-chan drew the sword she’d been carrying at her side and dashed forward. The way she sliced through the approaching monsters, as if dancing, was like a whirlwind.
However, her speed seems quite impressive. With minimal movement, she returned to the side of her Father. She’s swinging her sword to protect him.
Now that we know how far the Bio-Plant’s roots extend, there’s less to do. We can either take it out with herbicide or burn it down with fire Magic.
“Keel, team up with Sakura and go spray the herbicide on that main body.”
“Got it, big bro!”
Keel, riding on Sakura’s back, sprayed the herbicide that Father handed him. Not to be outdone, I’ll try spraying some herbicide from my spear, too.

It looks like we’ve dealt damage to the Bio-Plant. I can hear a scream that sounds like a cry of pain. However, that’s as far as it went—while some parts withered, the remaining sections regenerated rapidly.
“Hmm… Maybe it’s become a type with such high mutability that herbicide can’t take it down…?”
“What are we gonna do about this?!”
The Panda Beastman stepped forward to protect his subordinates and slashed at the encroaching plants with his claws. Wow, he’s got some pretty powerful arms.
“Motoyasu-kun! I think the main body is probably still in the roots. Since this used to be a wilderness… I think the main body is deep underground. Could you handle that?”
“Got it.”
Enemy intel you can’t get from the game, combined with Father’s deduction—that’s probably spot on.
“Aiming Lancer!”

Using multi-target selection, I fired the Aiming Lancer at the surrounding roots. The ground thudded and bucked as the bio-plant’s roots were torn apart and sent flying. We need to pinpoint exactly where the main body is.
The movement at the tips of the severed roots has stopped. We can safely assume it’s deep underground, inside that area.
“There’s only one thing to do.”
I thrust my spear into the ground and unleash my Skills.
“Earth Ignition!”

With a loud thud, the ground swells dramatically, then spews out whatever was buried beneath like a volcanic eruption. Exposed within it was something that appeared to be the Bio-Plant’s main body, with potato-like roots spreading throughout.
“Brionac X!”

Without hesitation, I fired a Brionac at the tuber and obliterated it. In the blink of an eye, the Bio-Plant withered away. Then, glowing seeds rained down from the roots of the destroyed Bio-Plant. This… it seems a single seed has multiplied into many.
“Hurry up and collect them! It’ll be a disaster if they sprout!”

After gathering a large number of fist-sized seeds, we took a breather. It seems the administrators of the Kingdom of Siltvelt are watching us from a distance. My Father can’t openly go to the castle, but it looks like he was spotted operating within the kingdom like this. That said, since he isn’t doing anything particularly conspicuous, people haven’t gone beyond mere suspicion.
“Seriously… what’s going on?”
The panda beastman mutters, clutching the seeds we’ve just gathered.
“Ah… well, we’ve got our own work to do, too.”
“You guys are a pretty unusual bunch, aren’t you?”
“I guess… so. I’d rather you didn’t worry about it too much. At least for now.”
“You make me dress in a way that doesn’t suit me, and that’s all you’ve got to say? Seriously… I hear the Shield Hero is in Melromarc… so who exactly are you guys?”
“Ugh…”
“I thought he was a strangely tough guy last time, too.”
Could it be that the panda beastman has subtly figured out the situation? If he went hunting with them, he’d have no choice but to understand just how tough his Father is.
“Big bro! The Shield—”
“Keel, stop it.”
His Father covered Keel’s mouth.
“Well, I’m a mercenary too. I have no intention of sticking my face into danger for no reason. Though I did have an unusual experience.”
The panda beastman’s subordinate nods vigorously. He has the same unassuming demeanor as Ren’s companions.
“For now…”
Father placed a Bio-Plant seed into his shield. He’s also gathering various other materials.
“Plant modification? …Hmm, hmm.”
My Father switched shields and activated the skill. I also inserted a seed into my spear to check it out.

Oh! Sure enough, the plant modification skill appeared. My Father must have used this to gradually improve the Bio-Plants. Spears obtained from plant-type monsters like Plant Rewe also seem to have the effect of expanding the skill’s capabilities.

Well, let’s leave this kind of detailed work to Father. Since Bio-Plant seeds are also treated as monsters, I checked the drop list. Sure enough, a Bio-Plant seed appeared. …I can extract it, but I don’t really see the point.
“So? What are we going to do now?”
“Since we’re done here, why don’t we go hunt some monsters with Lars-chan and the others to earn a little pocket money? Or maybe head to a shop somewhere?”
“Hmm, that’s a good question…”
“If there’s a cute clothing store, I’ll tag along. After all, they’ve been helping us out a lot.”
“Don’t tease me!”
It seems the panda beastman has really started to warm up to Father.
“Alright then, Motoyasu. I’m heading out with Lars-chan and the others.”
“Understood. We’ll meet up again when the time comes, then.”
“Yeah. Let’s go!”

Grabbing the panda beastman’s arm, my Father headed out with Sakura-chan and Keel. Yuki-chan and I were left behind in the former wasteland, where we explained the situation to the caretaker, a member of the Siltvelt.

For the time being, I considered learning the skill of plant modification and exploring whether I could create something with bio-plants in my own way, but it seemed like quite a hassle, and since it didn’t look like I’d be able to recreate Filolial-sama or anything like that, I decided to leave it alone. Just then, the egg I’d been keeping in my pocket hatched.
“Peep!”
It was a navy-blue Filolial-sama! As for its gender… it’s a female. It wasn’t Filo-tan after all. What should we name this little one?
“Peep!”
It’s full of energy—that’s good. Hmm, I see. Let’s have Father decide later.
“Alright then, Yuki-chan. I’ll take care of feeding this little one and leveling her up.”
“Got it!”
“Well then, let’s go for a run up the nearby pass!”
“Yes, ma’am!”
Yuki-chan really loves to run. That day, too, she worked hard on leveling up until just before sunset.
